blurb: Howard's Point Marina offers 14' fishing boats and 25' & 30' pontoons for rent. They provide wet and dry slips in various sizes and winter storage services including wrapping and storing boats. The marina is family-owned and located in Shorewood on Lake Minnetonka, serving the local boating community for nearly a century.
